title: Requests for fixes and workaround comments
summary: This topic centers on requests for fixes, mentions of temporary or manual workarounds, and one separate positive note about the interior design, so the examples are only loosely connected by the idea of a fix.

positive.summary: Positive feedback appears only in a comment praising the interior as creative and fun.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on frustration with a service center response that did not provide a real fix.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mostly ask for issues to be fixed or mention updates, dealer visits, manual actions, and temporary fixes without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined requests or repair mentions with too little context for reliable sentiment classification.
The cluster mixes multiple unrelated subjects such as seat issues, noise, software updates, trunk hardware, and a separate interior design compliment.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of overall owner experience.
